name: io.github.swimmwatch/cloakbrowser-mcp
title: CloakBrowser MCP
description: Model Context Protocol server for CloakBrowser — stealth Chromium browser automation for AI agents.

environmentVariables.name: CLOAKBROWSER_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory where screenshots, PDFs, traces, HAR files, and videos are written.

environmentVariables.name: CLOAKBROWSER_MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Logging verbosity: silent, error, warn, info, or debug.

environmentVariables.name: CLOAKBROWSER_MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated host suffix allowlist. Leave unset to allow all non-blocked origins.

environmentVariables.name: CLOAKBROWSER_MCP_BLOCKED_ORIGINS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated host suffix denylist. Denies override allowed origins.

environmentVariables.name: CLOAKBROWSER_MCP_HEADLESS
environmentVariables.description: Run the browser in headless mode.
